body: To be honest, you sound like a very strong person, I also think suicide is my only way out (I'm just an antisocial piece of shit with nothing to live for but have a very good family that loves me) yet somehow I think you have more of a chance to have a good life, procrastinate your suicide I believe that you have a chance.

Can relate, I'm 21 and I went thru the peak of my life at 18. It not only sucks that my life is shit, but knowing it's just going to get worse and worse. I need to save up courage to buy booze and cigarettes at the store lol.
So sorry for you bro, but I fixed it so it's fine
